policy.title: Our Security Philosophy
policy.content: SafeTools is built on the principle of Sovereign Security. We believe that security is not something you should have to trust a provider with; it's something you should be able to verify yourself.

noServers.title: NO PROCESSING SERVERS
noServers.desc: We maintain zero server infrastructure for processing your data. Our servers only provide the static code required to run tools in your browser.

noAccounts.title: NO USER ACCOUNTS
noAccounts.desc: By eliminating accounts, we eliminate the primary target for identity theft and data correlation.
